overview.purpose_zh: 这张漏斗图用来看网店从访问到下单的每一步还剩多少人，以及相邻两步之间流失了多少。
works_zh: 适合展示有固定顺序的流程，比如注册、结账、下单。
适合找出流失最大的那一步，再决定先改哪里。

understanding.read_zh: 从上往下读：每一层是该环节的人数，层与层之间的落差就是这一步流失的人。先看首尾，再找落差最大的那一段。

elements.note_zh: 每一层代表流程中的一个环节，条越宽人数越多。
条旁的数字是到达这一环节的月访客数。
右侧的百分比表示相对上一环节或第一步的比例。
相邻两层的差，就是这一步离开的人。

look_for_zh: 相邻两层落差最大的位置

observations.en: Visits fall from 10,000 to 760, so 9,240 of the 10,000 monthly visitors never buy.
observations.zh: 访问量从 10,000 降到 760，也就是说每月 10,000 名访客里有 9,240 人最终没有下单。

observations.en: The biggest drop is between product view and add to cart: 6,200 people become 1,900, a loss of 4,300.
observations.zh: 最大的流失出现在商品浏览和加入购物车之间：人数从 6,200 降到 1,900，少了 4,300 人。

observations.en: The checkout step loses the fewest people: 1,100 enter and 760 buy, a fall of 340.
observations.zh: 结账这一步流失的人最少：1,100 人进入，760 人下单，只少了 340 人。

observations.en: Only about one in three product viewers add an item to the cart.
observations.zh: 看过商品的人里，大约每三个才有一个把商品加入购物车。

describe.en: The funnel shows how 10,000 monthly visitors move through five stages to a purchase.
describe.zh: 这张漏斗图展示每月 10,000 名访客如何经过五个阶段走到下单。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + for whom + over what period
alternatives: The chart shows the monthly path from a first visit to a purchase.
The funnel tracks 10,000 visitors across five ordered stages.
describe.note_zh: 开头先交代人数和阶段，读者才知道后面每个数是什么口径。

describe.en: The whole process runs from the first visit to the completed order, and each stage is followed by the next one.
describe.zh: 整条流程从第一次访问走到完成下单，每一步之后接着下一步。
describe.pattern: the process of + -ing / a + adjective + process
alternatives: The purchase process has five ordered stages.
The process ends when a visitor places an order.

describe.en: At the product view stage, 6,200 of the 10,000 monthly visitors are still in the funnel.
describe.zh: 到了商品浏览阶段，每月 10,000 名访客里还有 6,200 人留在漏斗中。
describe.pattern: at the + adjective + stage / the first stage of + noun
alternatives: The product view stage holds 6,200 visitors.

describe.en: The conversion rate from product view to add to cart is about one in three: 1,900 of 6,200 people.
describe.zh: 从商品浏览到加入购物车的转化率约为三分之一：6,200 人里有 1,900 人。
describe.pattern: the conversion rate from A to B / a conversion rate of + percentage
alternatives: About one in three product viewers add an item to the cart.
1,900 of the 6,200 product viewers move on to the cart.
describe.note_zh: 转化率一定要说清从哪一步到哪一步，否则数字没有意义。

describe.en: More users drop off between product view and add to cart than at any other stage, a fall of 4,300.
describe.zh: 在商品浏览和加入购物车之间流失的用户最多，一下子少了 4,300 人。
describe.pattern: drop off at + stage / drop off between A and B
alternatives: The biggest drop-off point is between product view and add to cart.
4,300 users drop off before reaching the cart.

describe.en: Visitor numbers fall from 10,000 at the first stage to 760 at the last, with no increase anywhere.
describe.zh: 访客人数从第一阶段的 10,000 人一路下降到最后的 760 人，中间没有任何回升。
describe.pattern: fall + from ... to ... / fall by + amount
alternatives: Visits fall to 760 by the final stage.
The number of visitors falls at every stage.

describe.en: The number who buy is significantly less than the number who view a product: 760 against 6,200.
describe.zh: 真正下单的人数明显少于浏览商品的人数：760 对 6,200。
describe.pattern: A + be + significantly less than + B
alternatives: Purchases are far below product views, 760 against 6,200.
The buying group is much smaller than the browsing group.

describe.en: The store's overall conversion rate is low: 760 of 10,000 monthly visitors buy.
describe.zh: 这家店的总体转化率很低：每月 10,000 名访客里只有 760 人下单。
describe.pattern: conversion rate from A to B / a conversion rate of + percentage
alternatives: Only 760 of 10,000 visitors complete a purchase.
The visit-to-purchase conversion rate is under one in ten.

academic.en: The funnel tracks 10,000 monthly visitors across five ordered stages of an online purchase. Arrivals fall at every stage, from 10,000 at the visit stage to 6,200 at product view, 1,900 at add to cart, 1,100 at checkout, and 760 at purchase. The largest single fall occurs between product view and add to cart, where 4,300 visitors leave, while the smallest occurs between checkout and purchase, a loss of 340.
academic.zh: 这张漏斗图追踪每月 10,000 名访客在网店购买流程五个有序阶段中的人数变化。人数从访问阶段的 10,000 人持续下降到商品浏览阶段的 6,200 人、加入购物车的 1,900 人、结账的 1,100 人，最终到购买的 760 人。最大的单次下降出现在商品浏览到加入购物车之间，有 4,300 人离开；最小的下降出现在结账到购买之间，流失 340 人。

business.en: The funnel turns 10,000 monthly visits into 760 purchases, so most of the traffic never reaches the cart. The weak link is product view to add to cart: 6,200 people look at a product, but only 1,900 add it, a loss of 4,300. Fixing that step matters more than checkout, where 1,100 people arrive and 760 buy, a loss of 340.
business.zh: 这张漏斗图把每月 10,000 次访问变成 760 笔订单，大部分流量根本没走到购物车。最薄弱的环节是商品浏览到加入购物车：6,200 人看了商品，只有 1,900 人加入购物车，流失 4,300 人。优先改这一步，比改结账更值得，因为结账处有 1,100 人进入、760 人下单，只流失 340 人。

simple.en: The chart shows what happens after people visit an online store. In one month, 10,000 people arrive. Only 6,200 open a product page, and just 1,900 add something to the cart. At checkout there are 1,100 people, and 760 finish the order. The biggest fall is between the product page and the cart, where 4,300 people leave.
simple.zh: 这张图展示人们访问网店之后发生了什么。一个月里有 10,000 人进来，只有 6,200 人打开商品页，只有 1,900 人把商品加入购物车。到结账时有 1,100 人，最后 760 人完成下单。下降最大的一段在商品页和购物车之间，有 4,300 人离开。

language_notes.body_zh: by 后面跟减少的数量，to 后面跟降到的终点。看到 by 先找两个数的差，看到 to 直接写落点。
examples: Visits fell to 6,200 at product view.

language_notes.body_zh: drop off 说的是人离开流程，主语是人；drop 说的是数字下降，主语是数字。两者不要混用。
examples: More than 4,300 people drop off between product view and add to cart.
The number of visitors drops from 6,200 to 1,900.

language_notes.body_zh: 转化率要带两个端点，from A to B 说清分母和分子各是哪一步；只说 a low rate，听的人不知道从哪算到哪。
examples: The conversion rate from visit to purchase is under one in ten.
The conversion rate from product view to add to cart is about one in three.
